newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Suicide suspected in U.S. soldier's death -- NATO.
newsitem.headline: Suicide suspected in U.S. soldier's death -- NATO.

text.p: U.S. military authorities said on Thursday they were investigating an apparent suicide by an American soldier serving in the NATO-led peace force in Bosnia.
Sergeant Richmond Lauvai died on Wednesday afternoon from "an apparent self-inflicted gunshot wound", said a statement issued by a U.S. military base in northeast Bosnia.

Lauvai was assigned to the 18th infantry at an American base near the northern town of Brcko. Some 7,500 American soldiers are serving in the Stabilisation Force (SFOR) which polices the Dayton peace agreement that ended four years of war in former Yugoslavia.
More than 50 soldiers have died while serving in the alliance-led mission since it deployed in December 1995. Road accidents account for about a third of the casualties, NATO spokesmen said.
